oneOf.description: Positive decimal ID no greater than 9223372036854775807. Use a string for IDs outside the safe JSON integer range.

acquisitionMode.description: Directory template by source: single-import (one work), user (artist profile), series (series or collection), search (search results), quick (quick downloads). An empty mode template uses the default directory template.

username.description: Pixiv user name used by user-mode naming templates. Required and nonblank for acquisitionMode=user.

myPixiv.description: Use the bound Pixiv account for this personal source.

filters.description: Apply each range inclusively. The minimum may not exceed the corresponding maximum.

content.description: Rating to include. safe selects unrestricted works, r18 and r18g select their respective ratings, and r18plus includes both.

aiFilter.description: Include all works, exclude AI-generated works, or keep only AI-generated works.

typeFilter.description: Limit illustrations to the selected Pixiv artwork type.

tagsExact.description: Every listed tag must match a work tag or its translated name exactly.

tagsFuzzy.description: Every listed term must occur within a work tag or its translated name.

pagesMin.description: Minimum number of pages in an artwork, inclusive. This filters whole works.

pagesMax.description: Maximum number of pages in an artwork, inclusive. This filters whole works.

wordsMin.description: Inclusive lower bound on the word count reported by Pixiv for a novel.

wordsMax.description: Inclusive upper bound on the word count reported by Pixiv for a novel.

bookmarksMin.description: Inclusive lower bound on Pixiv bookmark count.

bookmarksMax.description: Inclusive upper bound on Pixiv bookmark count.

fileNameTemplate.description: Use the download scope of x-work-template-variables in GET /api/openapi.json.

bookmark.description: Bookmark the work on Pixiv after download.

collectionId.description: Local destination collection ID from GET /api/collections.

concurrent.description: Maximum number of works to process concurrently.

imageDelayMs.description: Delay between illustration images in milliseconds.

pageDelayMs.description: Minimum milliseconds between the starts of successive Pixiv search page requests. When omitted, the interval is 0 for a fixed page count and 10000 for maxPages=-1. Set 0 to skip the extra wait. Other sources ignore this setting.

verifyFiles.description: Check for local files when deciding whether an illustration has already been downloaded.

redownloadDeleted.description: Allow a previously recorded work whose local files have been deleted to be downloaded again.

novelMerge.description: Also export the novels together when a merged export is supported.

novelMergeFormat.description: Output file format for the merged novel export.

novelAutoTranslate.description: Request translation after downloading novel text.

novelTranslateLanguage.description: Target language for automatic novel translation.

novelTranslateSegmentSize.description: Text segment size used for automatic novel translation.

pathOverflowAction.description: When the output path is too long, ask for a decision, shorten the name, use its default name or cancel.

imageFormats.description: Formats to keep for still images, separated by commas. For a JPG source, webp removes the JPG after successful conversion, original,webp keeps both files, and jpg keeps the original JPG.

ugoiraFormats.description: Comma-separated output formats, each at most once.

mediaQuality.description: Lossy image encoding quality on a scale of 1 to 100.

mediaWebpLossless.description: Use lossless encoding for WebP output.

mediaMaximumEdge.description: Maximum output image edge, in pixels. Zero disables resizing by this option.

filters.description: Optional filters applied to discovered works before download.

download.description: Download, naming and output options for works found by this task.

fetchLimit.description: Zero means no item cap. Series scans the full series and explicit-list uses its supplied list.

kind.description: Choose illust for illustrations, manga or ugoira, or novel for novels.

word.description: Nonblank search text sent to Pixiv.

order.description: Pixiv result order: newest first (date_d), oldest first (date), or popularity (popular_d).

mode.description: Search all ratings (all), unrestricted works (safe), or adult works (r18). Pixiv may return unrestricted works or no results when searching anonymously or when the account hides age-restricted works. To download only R-18 or R-18G works, set filters.content to r18plus.

sMode.description: Search Pixiv tags with s_tag, or titles and descriptions with s_tc.

maxPages.description: A positive value caps the number of pages. Each page's work finishes before the next page is requested. Reaching fetchLimit or leaving work pending for retry stops paging. At -1, date_d uses the saved watermark and other orders stop at previously downloaded work.
